title: DAIQ: Auditing Demographic Attribute Inference from Neutral Question in LLMs
findings: This paper does not analyze or make findings related to religion. Religion is mentioned once in the introduction as an example of a sensitive attribute where LLMs can show bias, but it is not one of the five demographic attributes included in the DAIQ framework's evaluation.
